say:1:1721235001:1.text: Ah! Isn't that the prince's... ah... you know, the one who's always around him! It's been so long!
say:1:1721235001:1.source_cn: 啊呀！这不是王子殿下身边的……呃……那谁谁吗！好久不见啊！

say:2:1721235002:1.text: Is there something Baron Grandet can do for His Highness?
say:2:1721235002:1.source_cn: 是有什么我葛朗台能为王子殿下效劳的吗？

say:4:1721235003:1.text: Baron Grandet, I've been instructed to deliver this invitation to you on the prince's behalf.
say:4:1721235003:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，这是殿下让我带给您的邀请函。

say:6:1721235004:1.text: Prince Orion has heard the full story. The fish may have been worthless, but your loyalty was not.
say:6:1721235004:1.source_cn: 奥利安殿下听闻了整件事的前因后果。尽管霓光鲤未能起效，...

say:7:1721235005:1.text: In recognition of that loyalty, His Highness would like to invite you to join an upcoming private hunting outing.
say:7:1721235005:1.source_cn: 为表嘉奖，殿下特邀请您参与最近即将举行的行猎活动，一同游乐。

say:9:1721235006:1.text: Congratulations, Baron Grandet. It's a private hunt hosted by the prince himself, and as far as I know, you are the only baron invited.
say:9:1721235006:1.source_cn: 恭喜您，葛朗台男爵。这是场由殿下发起的私人行猎，据我所...

say:11:1721235008:1.text: D-Dura above, I... I... I'm deeply honored!
say:11:1721235008:1.source_cn: 艾……艾雅在上，我……我……我实在是太荣幸了！

say:12:1721235009:1.text: I knew it! I knew that million wasn't wasted! I, Grandet, never make a losing investment! Hahaha!
say:12:1721235009:1.source_cn: 我就知道我的一百万金不是白花的！我葛朗台，从不做亏本的...

say:13:1721235010:1.text: Reporters, pens ready! Forget everything before this—this is the moment worth writing down.
say:13:1721235010:1.source_cn: 诸位记者朋友们，快拿起笔吧！这正是历史性的一幕，真正值...

narration:14:1721235011:1.text: Grandet comes back to life instantly, waving the invitation at the reporters like he's already turned the whole disaster into a personal triumph.

narration:15:1721235012:1.text: Well, that seems to be the end of it. Time to give the queen the full report.
